props.name: accept
props.description:
Acceptable file types for upload
- Example: '.jpg, .png, .gif'

props.name: ariaDescribedBy
props.description:
Aria described-by attribute
- Connects the field note in the select to the select menu for accessibility

props.name: fileSizeLimit
props.description: Maximum file size allowed for upload in MB

props.name: hideLabel
props.description: Indicates if the label is hidden

props.name: isDisabled
props.description: Indicates if the field is disabled

props.name: isError
props.description: Indicates if the field note is in error state

props.name: isRequired
props.description: Indicates if the field is required

props.name: multiple
props.description: Allows multiple files to be added to the file upload

props.name: textConfig
props.description:
Configuration for text messages in file upload
- Specifies error text for unsupported file formats and size exceeded messages

props.name: uploadFiles
props.description:
Files to be uploaded from the application
- Represents the status of the files

props.name: uploadTime
props.description:
Time taken for uploading
- Defaults to 1 second

events.name: onFileUploadFileRemove
events.description: Fired when a file is removed. Detail: `{ updatedFiles }` — the remaining files after removal, not the removed one.

events.name: onFileUploadFileUpload
events.description: Fired when files are added. Detail: `{ uploadedFiles }` — the files accepted by this interaction.
